title: Kleinanzeigen Listing Details Scraper
description: Get full Kleinanzeigen listing details by one ad ID or a batch of up to 100 IDs in a single run.

ad_id.title: Listing Ad ID
ad_id.description: A single Kleinanzeigen listing ID. It can be combined with ad_ids.

ad_ids.title: Listing Ad IDs
ad_ids.description: Optional batch of up to 100 listing IDs. Duplicate IDs are fetched once in first-seen order.

query.title: Find a current listing
query.description: When no ad_id or ad_ids is supplied, search this query and save the first successful listing detail (up to three candidates). Explicit IDs take priority.
